content:
gabi: New team trying the quickstart. Followed the Go guide, exported REDWOOD_KEY from env, but first POST to /v1/chat returns 402 Payment Required even though the workspace UI shows a trial. Anyone seen a billing gate that only appears after an initial key rotation?

noel: Was the workspace created via invite or SSO? Also did you rotate the key after creating the org?

gabi: Invite. We used the web console to create the workspace and then rotated the service key (clicked rotate) because we thought the first one leaked. Exported the new key and restarted the sample. Host curl with the new key works, but the quickstart binary still returns 402.

priya: Can you paste the curl and the API response? 402 responses usually include billing_url.

gabi: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/rot-999/billing"}}
```

noel: Two leads: (1) key rotation sometimes leaves behind a cached token in runners or config files; (2) frontend can show trial active while backend provisioning/state reconciliation is still in progress. Which SDK and starter version are you using?

gabi: Starter: go-starter@main from this morning. Go SDK 1.0.0 in the image. The quickstart logs say "Using REDWOOD_KEY from /etc/redwood/credentials (masked)" even though I exported the new key in my shell and restarted the service.

priya: Sounds like the container/quickstart prefers the file over env. We had a number of issues where users rotate keys in the console but forget to update baked-in config files or systemd unit files. Also note that some SDKs had default retries that spam 402s which confuses users.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-260 onboarding-rotation-config-cache-and-billing  https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-260

noel: Short-term checklist: (A) verify which key the running process actually sent (print masked key hash), (B) check /v1/workspaces/me to confirm state=="active", (C) avoid automatic retries on 402 in quickstart so logs are readable.

gabi: I dumped process env from the running container and it shows NEW_ key present, but the app still logs that it's reading from the file. Replaced the file with the new key and restarted; first request then returned 200. So this was config precedence + rotation confusion.

priya: Action items: Starter change to prefer env > file > keychain and add explicit log: "Using REDWOOD_KEY from env|file|keychain (••••)". Also quickstart should run a preflight GET /v1/workspaces/me and wait up to 60s for state=="active" instead of issuing the first POST immediately. We'll also change the starter to not retry on 402.

sdk-team: Filed SDK ticket SDK-589: "Expose wait_for_workspace_ready helper; treat 402 billing_required as terminal in default retry policy".

starter-bot: Issue opened: redwood-inference/starter#954 "prefer REDWOOD_KEY env over file after key rotation + preflight workspace check" (includes repro and patch).

gabi: Quick workaround that unblocked us: check process logs for key source, replace file if needed, then confirm GET /v1/workspaces/me shows active. After that the first POST succeeded. I'll open a PR with a small addition to the README to mention key rotation pitfalls.

noel: Good plan. Long-term: backend should surface a clearer provenance indicator for the workspace UI (e.g., "billing provisioning in progress") and the SDK helper can give an immediate human-friendly hint instead of raw 402.

priya: I'll add a follow-up in the onboarding docs and coordinate the starter PR with SDK changes so quickstarts have the helper available.

gabi: Thanks all  will link the PR and incident once done. Closing the thread for now. :white_check_mark:
